text: The company's remote work policy allows employees to work from home up to three days per week, subject to manager approval and team coverage requirements.
Our data retention policy requires that customer records be archived for seven years and then permanently deleted unless legal hold applies.
Onboarding for new engineering hires includes a two-week ramp-up period covering codebase architecture, deployment pipelines, and on-call rotation training.
The incident response runbook specifies that any Sev-1 outage must be acknowledged within five minutes and a postmortem published within 48 hours.
Expense reimbursement requires itemized receipts for any purchase above twenty five dollars, submitted within thirty days of the expense date.
